reason_for_change: The student requested simulated judgments. Codex generated the reference suggestions and is credited as their author. The instructor-recommended personal hand-check is not recorded as completed.
case_composition: Ten fictional pairs in pre-existing order: five AI PM and five commercial PM roles.
label_rule: Three distinct, role-relevant preparation capabilities with comparatively weak profile evidence; exact source excerpts, reasons, alternatives and qualitative confidence recorded before predictions.
run_rule: One attempt per case per mode, with unchanged production prompt and validators. No outcome-driven label changes, prompt tuning or successful-only reruns. Any later revised run must use a separate version and preserve this run.

metrics.mean_top3_overlap_all_cases: Sum of matched gap IDs divided by 3 times all ten cases; abstentions contribute zero.
metrics.case_agreement_at_least_two: Number of cases sharing at least two of three reference IDs divided by all ten cases.
metrics.coverage: Accepted complete three-gap responses divided by all ten cases.
metrics.conditional_agreement: Agreement among accepted cases only, reported alongside all-case results and coverage.
metrics.cost: Sum of response-reported usage.cost including rejected responses; missing costs remain unknown, not zero. This is not an invoice.
metrics.latency: Measured end-to-end pipeline time per attempted case. Sequential small-sample timing is not a production latency benchmark.

limitations: Model-to-model reference agreement is not correctness, hiring suitability, user value or an achieved human-reference target.
One assistant family contributed fictional inputs, taxonomy and labels, creating shared framing bias.
No human-verified labels or independent semantic evaluation are supplied by this exploratory study.
After suggestions are viewed, a later review of these cases is AI-assisted; fresh blind validation requires unseen cases or an independent unexposed reviewer.
Original pending human decision files and the original evaluator's human-reference gate remain unchanged.
